note: Wording for scripts/make-og-card.ps1. Kept outside the script because Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads BOM-less .ps1 files as the ANSI code page and turns Japanese literals into mojibake. The script reads this file with an explicit UTF-8 decoder, so the encoding of this file (UTF-8, with or without BOM) does not change the output.
